abstract_research_topics.justification: Sequence-to-sequence models are abstract architectural frameworks used to map sequences from one domain to sequences in another domain and are foundational in many applications but represent an abstract research focus.
Sequence modeling is about the theoretical concepts and methodologies for training models to process sequences, and is a base research topic in machine learning.
Like sequence-to-sequence models, sequence models relate to the theoretical and architectural aspects of handling sequential data in deep learning.
Refers to general studies over various types of models handling sequences, focusing on methodologies and theories rather than specific applications.
The focus here is on the theoretical aspects of generating sequences which is a general method applicable across domains.
Concerns with predicting next items in sequences, underlying many practical applications but addresses the theoretical and methodological constructs of deep learning.

application_domains.justification: Practical application in natural language processing aimed at generating questions based on input text, used in education and testing systems.
Application-focused on enhancing text generation models with external information retrieval, used in systems that require accurate and contextually enriched output.
An application domain; often linked to optimization and operations research problems handled by iterative column generation approaches.
Application domain that concerns generating text with specific attributes or controlled features desired by the user.
An application domain focused on the task of generating human-like text from data, widely used in chatbots, summarization, and reporting.
Application-oriented area dealing with the creation of text using machine learning models.
Focuses on the practical implementation of models designed to generate coherent and contextually relevant text.
Application domain focusing on employing deep learning techniques to solve practical problems in biological sequence analysis.

application_domains.value: natural language processing for biological sequence design
application_domains.justification: Application of NLP techniques particularly designed for problems in biological sequences, aiding in sequence and feature extraction or design.
Practical domain dealing with the design and manipulation of biological sequences to achieve desired properties or functionalities.
Application domain focusing on engineering and modifying biological sequences for various industrial and research applications.
Application domain that involves converting natural language queries into SQL queries, widely used for database interactions.
Focuses on the application of parsing techniques to convert text to structured SQL queries to perform specific data retrieval operations.
Application of using prompts to navigate or refine model interactions, often used in practical machine learning tasks, like fine-tuning language models.
An application domain concerned with the crafting and optimizing of prompts to achieve desired outputs from models, widely used in AI-driven text and dialogue systems.
Application-related to enhancing prompt efficiency and effectiveness to improve output quality in practical deployments of language models.
Practical applications in generating conversational agents modeled to interact with humans, widely used in customer service and personal assistants.
Application-oriented dealing with systems designed for human-machine interactions, including conversational models for various uses.
Focuses on the design and implementation of systems allowing human-computer dialogue, used in customer service, tutoring, etc.
